objective: Determine whether one fixed Qwen3.5-35B-A3B/vLLM-0.26/H20 stack executes genuine native ragged and continuous batching, without relabelling the earlier sequential scheduler-interleave or two-CUDA-stream experiments.

prior_node_status.terminal_condition: pod deleted externally before upload or execution

fixed_stack.hardware: one NVIDIA H20-3e (compute capability 9.0, at least 140 GiB GPU memory)

data_selection: first three distinct rows of the frozen PG19-train smoke64 JSONL; tokenize the first 50000 text characters locally; take the exact prefix lengths below

requests.lifecycle_role: waiting replacement admitted while B remains live

engine_config.engine: vLLM V1 LLM offline engine with the configured native Scheduler subclass observer

full_vocab_logprob_tolerance.comparison: all vocabulary entries at every generated step; identical finite/non-finite mask required

required_positive_gates: the same native SchedulerOutput admits A and B as new requests with distinct prompt lengths 1105 and 2209
at least one later native SchedulerOutput contains cached decode work for both A and B
A reaches a terminal free receipt before B
a later native SchedulerOutput admits new request C while cached request B remains scheduled
scheduler-observed simultaneously live KV block IDs are pairwise disjoint within every cache group
every block ID reported as newly allocated to a new request is present in that step's native new_block_ids_to_zero receipt
sequential A/B/C controls never contain more than one request in a SchedulerOutput
native-batch and sequential-control generated token IDs are exactly equal for A, B, and C
native-batch and sequential-control full-vocabulary output log-probabilities meet the preregistered tolerance for A, B, and C
scientific_negative_policy: If any required positive gate fails after model execution, preserve the result as a completed scientific negative; do not relabel or automatically add it to the manuscript.
infrastructure_failure_policy: Failures before any model execution are infrastructure/preflight failures, not scientific negatives.

eligible_if_all_gates_pass: native vLLM scheduler ragged admission for two different-length requests
native continuous-batching turnover from finished A to waiting C while B remains live
greedy-token and full-vocabulary output-log-prob comparison against sequential controls on this fixed stack
not_established: integration of the existing in-process CoMem/ForkAudit cache facade into vLLM EngineCore
ForkAudit GDN ownership under native batching
native-batching throughput, capacity, cancellation, or production safety
